title: ⏺️▶️Qalibaf Departs for Baghdad at the Head of Parliamentary Delegation- Tehran – August 19, 2026
text:
⏺️▶️Qalibaf Departs for Baghdad at the Head of Parliamentary Delegation- Tehran – August 19, 2026"

"Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf left Tehran for Baghdad, the capital of Iraq, on Wednesday at the head of a high-ranking parliamentary delegation."

"The visit aims to discuss regional developments, strengthen strategic cooperation between Tehran and Baghdad, and explore joint mechanisms to help establish stability and security in West Asia.
